title: Reading the daily solar-term summary
scenario: For a Korean forecast, the service ranks daily weather and solar terms. The screens below use synthetic weather data.

steps.title: Read today’s forecast on a phone
steps.instruction: Open the weather forecast for a Korean location. Look below the current temperature for the daily summary.
steps.caption: In this example the summary gives the daily temperature range and names Chubun.
steps.expected: On a day with more urgent air or weather conditions, those messages can occupy both slots.

steps.title: Read the same forecast on desktop
steps.instruction: Open the same location in the desktop WebApp. The daily summary appears in the current-weather card.
steps.caption: Both layouts show the summary selected by the weather service. The display does not require a calendar request.
steps.expected: After midnight in Korea, the previous day’s solar-term summary expires, including when viewing a saved forecast.

steps.title: Read the forecast on Android
steps.instruction: Open the Korean place in the forecast tab. Read the summary below the current conditions.
steps.caption: The example ends with the name 입춘. The temperature range and the term share the same summary.
steps.expected: Open the separate air-quality card to see air details.
